CapHero.Headline:
Your AI
Starter Kit

Deliverable.title: AI Opportunity Audit Worksheet
Deliverable.Description: Fill in before your call. Covers your role, AI tools you use, top time drains, and what you want to walk away with. Takes 5 minutes — makes the call twice as useful.

Deliverable.title: What's Actually Working in AI
Deliverable.Description: An opinionated briefing on the current AI landscape. The models worth knowing, the tools earning their keep, and what to skip — updated for 2026.

Deliverable.title: AI Prompt Starter Kit
Deliverable.Description: 25 practitioner-grade prompts across 5 roles: Executive, Product, Operations, Writing, and AI-Native workflows. Searchable, filterable, one-click copy.

Deliverable.title: AI Landscape Mindmap
Deliverable.Description: A visual map of the full AI landscape — models, use cases, tools, agentic systems, infrastructure, and adoption strategy. Use it to locate where you are today.

Deliverable.title: Post-Call Action Plan
Deliverable.Description: Sent to you within 24 hours of your call. Your top 3 AI opportunities, a prioritised first step, what to avoid, and follow-up from Chu. Download as PDF.
